ResearchProjectDef.label: boats
ResearchProjectDef.description: Motor boats and trawlers; their hulls are sealed vehicle bodies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: trucks
ResearchProjectDef.description: Trucks and military transports: heavy machines on several wheeled chassis.

ResearchProjectDef.label: armor plates
ResearchProjectDef.description: Hardened steel armour plate for armoured cars, APCs and the sides of tanks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: weapon mounts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turret mounts that fit HSK weapons to vehicles: light armament (machine guns and flamethrowers), launchers, autocannons and mortars, and fire control systems. The heavier mounts also need the research of their weapon.

ResearchProjectDef.label: aviation II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gas turbines: helicopters and transport aircraft.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tracked vehicles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tracked running gear: flame tanks and medium tanks. Composite armour and tank guns build on it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: composite armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Heavy armour plate of depleted uranium, ceramics and carbon composite for tank fronts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: tank guns
ResearchProjectDef.description: Tank guns with recoil systems and stabilisers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital drop pods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reusable drop pods and their impulse drive units: thrusters, power cells and a flight computer.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital assault pods
ResearchProjectDef.description: Armoured orbital assault pods with an artillery mount.

ResearchProjectDef.label: main battle tank
ResearchProjectDef.description: The design of a modern main battle tank.
